title: Two weights, one loss
summary: Follow gradient descent across a bowl-shaped loss surface using two weights.

formula.latex: L(x,y)=\frac{1}{2}(x^2+10y^2),\quad g_x=x,\quad g_y=10y,\quad x'=x-\eta g_x,\quad y'=y-\eta g_y

symbols.meaning: Loss: the height of the surface that we want to reduce.
First weight; x′ is its next value.
Second weight; y′ is its next value.
First gradient component: the loss slope in the first weight direction.
Second gradient component: the loss slope in the second weight direction.
Learning rate: how strongly each gradient component changes its weight.
